about_the_game:
《No Slack Pets》— Your ultimate productivity tool and healing companion, bringing joy and surprises to your serious life!

"An electronic pet and your ‘keyboard buddy’!"

✨ Core Gameplay ✨

1."Fingertip Interaction: Your actions are your pet's ‘daily grind’!"Real-time follow & typing count: 

  • Every key you press is your pet’s “hard work”! Whether you're typing, coding, or playing games, your little buddy will follow along, tapping the keyboard with its paws, transforming the boring task into a cute mini performance! Every keystroke is recorded, and your accumulated achievements can open surprise treasure chests and unlock exclusive badges, showcasing your little

    wins!

2."Hang Out and Get Surprises: Open a treasure chest every 30 minutes to win stylish headgears!"

  • Mysterious treasure chest drops: Even if you're away or focusing on work, your pet patiently waits in the background. Every 30 minutes, a surprise "Mystery Chest" will automatically appear! Open it, and you may get a trendy headgear that can be traded on the Steam Community Market! From the quirky clown hat, the adorable frog hat, to the cool pirate hat… there are tons of collectible styles waiting for you!

3."DIY Freedom: Build your exclusive cute pet universe!"Endless pet styles: 

  • Watermelon heads, bunny ears, starry eyes, sad faces… Over 100 accessories (and counting!) including headgear, facial expressions, and small items, all for mixing and matching to create your one-of-a-kind virtual companion!

4.Cozy Spaces: Build and personalize your pet’s world:

  • Travel through a forest cabin, a magical mushroom house, or a sweet ice cream house! Unlock various stunning scenes and personalize with figurines, murals, and lamps. You can even switch between day and night, or change the weather—enjoy the peace with the sound of rain, or work late into the night with your pet by your side, enhancing the atmosphere!

🎮 Upcoming Features:

Not just a game, but your "Desktop Life Partner"

  • Surprise Steam Inventory: Rare headgear may drop while the game runs in the background, and you can even craft exclusive limited-edition items! Get ready for surprise gift boxes—perfect for collectors!

  • Efficiency Boosters: Your ideal work and study partner! Includes a to-do list, focus timer (Pomodoro clock), and seamless interaction with your pet, making productive time feel special!

  • Continued Evolution, More Surprises: Future updates will add more interactive features like pet speech bubbles, curated ambient music (coffee shop whispers, forest birds…), creating your very own "Cute Pet Workspace"!

🌟 Why Choose "No Slack Pets"?

✅ Cute is Justice: Chibi art style and expressive faces that will win over all pet lovers!

✅ Easy and Stress-free: Get rewards even when you're idling, turning fragmented time into a sense of achievement!

✅ Social & Collecting: With Steam inventory and UGC outfits, make your pet shine on your social feed!

✅ Healing Companion: Whether you’re a worker, student, streamer, or anyone else, there's a pet that understands your hard work and passion!

Join "No Slack Pets" now! Make every keystroke a surprise and have the warmest companion by your side in your busy life!

👉 Click Follow for the latest updates! The Playtest version will be available soon, stay tuned!

﻿

Playtest version headgears drop rate:

  • Common 90.00%

  • Uncommon 9.51%

  • Rare 0.49%

  • Later versions will add epic, legendary and other headgears, and the drop will change at that time
